mapper.update: UPDATE document_ingestion_runs SET status = #{status}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('FAILED', 'CUTOVER_COMPLETE') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_at END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, document_id, docling_task_id, status, started_at, completed_at FROM document_ingestion_runs WHERE id = #{id}
